name: Data.Pair.xiSum_mem
summary: The class sum with Mk stays in N, and every coefficient is l-integral.

steps.claim: Mk times a class sum of elements of N lies in N (the stabiliser orders divide Mk: smul_classSum_mem, card_classAut_dvd_chosenGroupOrder); each coefficient den/N(Q)^{m−1}·⟨1, den·Ξ(h)⟩ is l-integral: den is an integer, N(Q) is an l-adic unit (l ∤ N(Q)), and the Gram pairing of integral vectors is integral (gramForm_mem_embValRing; the values of den·Ξ are integral: weylGauge_pointKernel_le_one).
steps.lean:
∀ h, F h ∈ N) : xiSum H ϑ F ∈ N := smul_classSum_mem N (D.card_classAut_dvd_chosenGroupOrder
  (H.2.1 ▸ D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound) levelOf_le_Kf) (N.smul_mem ⟨_, mul_mem
  (by simp [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, norm_natCast_le_one, hl.norm_natCast_eq_one, -Nat.cast_prod])
  (by simpa [trivialLift_apply, smul_sum] using sum_mem fun _ _ ↦ gramForm_mem_embValRing _ (by
  simp [weylGauge, weylRep, schur_eq_one, H]) (weylGauge_pointKernel_le_one (hl := hl) ..))⟩ <| h ·)
